title: Wearable Copper Golems
description: Makes copper golem blocks equippable on player heads.
body:
A simple datapack that makes **Copper Golem Statues wearable**.

Also available as packaged mods for various mod loaders. Since this datapack only changes the copper golem statue loot tables, it has **absolutely zero impact on performance**.

![wearing copper golem statues](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c66e8d849d25f1923acc7bfdafbb5f2fa8a359ae.png)

To wear a copper golem statue, break any copper golem statue then right click to wear it as any other helmet would work. Can also be dispensed and swapped.
